summary: Gold Mountain lookout in Douglas County run by Coos FPA; newspapers place staff on the peak in 1924-1931, register dates it 1935, gone by 1966.

staffing.status: staffed by Coos FPA as a fire lookout in the 1920s and in 1931, per newspaper items

facts.status_note: Gone by 1966; no source describes what remains on the summit.

events.note: Register gives 1935; firelookout.com lists 1935 with the entry marked unknown. Newspaper items from 1924 and 1925 describe an earlier lookout on Gold Mountain, which the sources do not reconcile.
Mrs. Charles Crouch kept a summer vigil on Gold Mountain as a fire lookout (Twin Falls Weekly News, April 1924).
Gold Mountain listed among the lookout stations maintained by Coos FPA, Eden Ridge district (Coos Bay Times, December 1925).
Harold Dick of Camas Valley took the Gold Mountain station; Lee Wagner was stationed there for two weeks before moving to Bone Mountain (Roseburg News-Review, June 1931).
Register and firelookout.com both give 'gone' by 1966; neither gives a removal date or cause.
Registered with the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on December 18, 2010.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and firelookout.com give 1935. Newspaper items from April 1924 and December 1925 describe a fire lookout on Gold Mountain before that date. The story gives both and does not choose between them; the sources do not explain the gap.

notes_for_editor: Main issue: the register and firelookout.com date the lookout to 1935, but 1924 and 1925 newspaper items quoted on the Oregon lookouts site describe a Gold Mountain fire lookout earlier. Not resolved. Record coordinates (42.85302, -123.79253) match the register; the brief notes a conflicting West US lookouts position (42.8461, -123.7911), which was not checked here. The weebly page calls the agency 'Coos County Fire Patrol' and has a 'Removed' field with no date, so no removal cause is given. No design, access or remains information found, so those keys are omitted. No photos found.
